description.p: FastSync keeps a folder in sync with Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or MEGA, both ways, with every file available offline. Log in through your browser, choose the folders, and it runs from the tray.

Changes are noticed straight away: edits on your computer through inotify, and edits in the cloud through each service's own change feed, without listing the whole tree again. If both sides changed a file, both copies are kept. Files removed in the cloud go to a trash folder instead of being deleted, and a run that would delete too many files stops and asks first.
More reliable, and faster with ignore rules.

ul.li: FastSync restarts its sync helper (rclone) if it ever stops, and one account's internal error no longer affects the others.
Pause now stops a sync that is already running.
Folders hidden by ignore rules are no longer scanned, which is much faster for things like node_modules.
Files from other sync clients (.dropbox, .DS_Store, Office lock files and similar) are never synced.
Identical files are no longer duplicated as conflicts when the check itself fails; it is retried instead.
Removing an account clears its old trash items; the rest stays in .fastsync/trash.
The first scan of a big cloud shows its progress.
